question: Return the number of orders received for Pride and Prejudice.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders_items" AS SELECT "idorder" AS "idorder", "isbn_amount" AS "isbn_amount" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders" AS SELECT "idorder" AS "idorder", "idclient" AS "idclient", "dateorder" AS "dateorder", "dateexped" AS "dateexped" FROM table_6;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH pride AS (
  SELECT b.isbn
  FROM books b
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(b.title)) = 'pride and prejudice'
), parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.idorder,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(oi.isbn_amount, '-', 1) AS BIGINT) AS isbn_parsed
  FROM orders_items oi
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.idorder) AS pride_orders
FROM parsed p
JOIN pride b ON p.isbn_parsed = b.isbn;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 4 AS pride_orders;
